name: grp-mcp-mac
description: Superseded by the grp-mcp plugin, which is cross-platform as of 0.81.0-rc15 and identical to this one; this stays published so existing macOS and Linux installs keep updating. It existed because grp-mcp used to bundle a Windows .exe that a Mac could not execute; both now run the same code through uvx, so the split has no purpose left. Install ONE of the two, never both - they register the same server name. Needs uv: 'brew install uv'. Run the grp-mcp-setup command in this plugin's README once to create your connections file; the server then finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc41): identical to grp-mcp. On a screen still on the Classic UI, an edit to an existing grid row through the modern-UI tools was silently dropped and the grid read back with empty values (found on Chart of Accounts, GL202500, on a 2026R1 site). The tools now read such a grid again the way the Modern UI does, so the values show and the edit is saved. Adding rows was never affected. Not yet checked on a 2025R1 site. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
